title: 赠汪伦
author: 李白
intro: Li Bai is about to sail away when he hears his friend Wang Lun singing goodbye on the shore. The Peach Blossom Pool is a thousand feet deep — but not as deep as this friendship.
analysis: 李白游览泾县桃花潭的时候，当地人汪伦热情地招待了他。李白坐上船正要走，忽然听见岸上传来“踏歌”声——一边走一边用脚打拍子唱歌，原来是汪伦带着人来送行了。诗的前两句像在讲故事：一个要走，一个来送，“忽闻”写出李白没想到的惊喜。后两句把看不见的感情和看得见的潭水放在一起比：桃花潭的水有一千尺深，也比不上汪伦送我的情谊深。这种写法叫“比较”，用具体的东西衬出抽象的感情。诗人还直接把自己和朋友的名字写进诗里，读起来自然、亲切、真诚。从此汪伦这个普通人因为一首诗被记住了一千多年，“桃花潭水”也成了深厚友谊的代称。
analysisEn: While visiting the Peach Blossom Pool in Jing County (in today’s Anhui), Li Bai was warmly hosted by a local man named Wang Lun. Li Bai had boarded a boat and was about to leave when he suddenly heard tà gē on the shore — singing while stamping out the rhythm with your feet. It was Wang Lun, come with friends to see him off. The first two lines tell the story: one man leaving, one man arriving to say goodbye, and 忽闻 (“suddenly heard”) catches Li Bai’s happy surprise. The last two lines compare something invisible with something you can see: the Peach Blossom Pool is a thousand feet deep, yet still not as deep as Wang Lun’s feeling for him. Using a concrete thing to measure an abstract feeling makes it easy to grasp. Li Bai even puts his own name and his friend’s right into the poem, which makes it sound natural, warm and sincere. Thanks to these four lines, an ordinary man has been remembered for over a thousand years, and “the water of Peach Blossom Pool” became a byword for deep friendship.
background: Li Bai (701–762) visited Jing County around 755. Little is known about Wang Lun; later stories say he invited Li Bai with a playful letter promising “ten li of peach blossoms” and “ten thousand wine shops” — which turned out to be a pool called Peach Blossom and an inn run by a family named Wan. The story is traditional and may not be true.
pronunciation: 乘舟 chéng zhōu（不读 shèng）；将欲行 jiāng（将要）；踏歌 tà gē。
version: 采用通行的教材版本，各本基本无异文。

lines.py: lǐ bái chéng zhōu jiāng yù xíng
lines.lit: Li Bai, aboard a boat, is about to go,
lines.en: I, Li Bai, had boarded, ready to sail,

lines.py: hū wén àn shàng tà gē shēng
lines.lit: when suddenly he hears singing and stamping on the shore.
lines.en: when singing and stamping rose from the bank.

lines.py: táo huā tán shuǐ shēn qiān chǐ
lines.lit: The water of Peach Blossom Pool is a thousand feet deep,
lines.en: Peach Blossom Pool is a thousand feet deep,

lines.py: bù jí wāng lún sòng wǒ qíng
lines.lit: but does not reach the feeling with which Wang Lun sees me off.
lines.en: yet not as deep as Wang Lun’s farewell to me.

words.en: to give as a gift; (of a poem) for

words.note: 乘：坐，现代汉语“乘车”“乘客”；舟：船。
将、欲都是“将要”的意思；现代汉语说“正要”。

words.en: to sing while stamping out the beat
words.note: 一种民间歌唱方式，边走边用脚打拍子；今天少见。

words.en: not as good as; not reach
words.note: 现代汉语仍用，如“我不及他高”；也有“来不及”。

imagery.name: 桃花
imagery.zh: 桃花潭的名字带来美丽、温暖的画面，衬出友情的美好。
imagery.en: The pool’s name, Peach Blossom, brings a warm, lovely picture that matches the friendship.

imagery.name: 水
imagery.zh: 千尺深的潭水被用来衡量友情，可是还比不上友情深。
imagery.en: The thousand-foot pool is used to measure the friendship — and still falls short.
